title: Print Production — PDF/A-2b and PDF/X-4 in one file

metadata.author: pdfnative-cli samples
metadata.subject: The archival and the press claim in the same file (ISO 19005-2 + ISO 15930-7, pdfnative ≥ 1.9.0): pdfaid and pdfxid in XMP, two OutputIntents on one CMYK profile
metadata.keywords: print, pdf/a-2b, pdf/x-4, dual claim, archival, prepress

outputIntent.info: A structurally valid, colourimetrically meaningless CMYK press profile shipped with the samples.

blocks.text: Rendered with: pdfnative render --input 09-dual-pdfa2b-pdfx4.json --pdfx pdfx4 --tagged pdfa2b --output-intent-icc synthetic-cmyk.icc --font latin --lang latin --trapped false --strict. The XMP packet carries pdfaid (part 2, conformance B) and pdfxid (GTS_PDFXVersion PDF/X-4) through the PDF/X ID extension schema; the catalog lists two OutputIntents — /GTS_PDFA1 and /GTS_PDFX — on the same embedded ICC stream; the header says PDF 1.6; /Trapped is False.

PDF/A-2b and PDF/A-2u combine with PDF/X-4. PDF/A-1 is PDF 1.4 while PDF/X-4 needs PDF 1.6, and PDF/A-3 allows embedded files that PDF/X-4 forbids: the engine refuses those two pairs with a level-specific message (E_INPUT), which --dry-run reports before anything is written.

pdfnative inspect --check pdfa,pdfx asserts the two claims in one exit code; veraPDF validates the PDF/A-2b half, pdfnative's structural validator the PDF/X-4 half — the conformance corpus of this repository runs both.
